DEINDE ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS / LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 9, 2026

DEINDE Enterprise Solutions (“DEINDE,” “we,” “us”) is a North Carolina-based social enterprise. This notice describes information associated with visiting deinde-website.vercel.app (the “Site”) and contacting us through the Site. This policy covers the website, not separate programs or services that may have additional privacy notices.

1. Information you choose to share

The Site provides an inquiry form that asks for your name, email address, optional organization name, area of interest, and message. The current website generates an email draft on your device; it does not submit these entries to a DEINDE website database. Information reaches DEINDE only if you choose to send the email or otherwise contact us. Emails you send may be retained in DEINDE’s email account and associated systems.

2. Information processed in delivering the Site

DEINDE uses third-party website hosting and supporting services. When you visit the Site, these providers may automatically process technical information such as IP address, browser and device details, requested pages, timestamps, and security or performance logs according to their configurations and policies. The Site also loads fonts from Google Fonts, which may receive technical request information when those resources are loaded.

3. How information is used

Information sent to DEINDE may be used to review and respond to inquiries, discuss potential services or opportunities, coordinate a requested follow-up, maintain business records, protect against spam or abuse, and comply with legal obligations. Website technical information may be processed by service providers to deliver, protect, and maintain the Site.

4. Disclosures and providers

Information may be handled by our email provider, website host, and other service providers as needed to operate the Site and answer messages. We may also disclose information when legally required or necessary to protect rights, safety, and security. We do not claim that all hosting or email-related data remains on DEINDE-controlled systems.

5. Cookies and analytics

The website code reviewed on November 9, 2026 does not include a dedicated visitor analytics script, advertising pixel, or custom cookie-based tracking feature. Hosting and third-party resources may nevertheless use technical identifiers or logs. If DEINDE adds analytics, advertising tools, or additional cookies, this notice should be reviewed and updated before those features are enabled.

6. Data retention and security

Messages and related records are retained as needed for business communications, recordkeeping, legal compliance, and security, subject to the practices of the email and hosting providers involved. We use reasonable safeguards appropriate to the information and the services used, but no email or internet transmission can be guaranteed fully secure. Please do not send Social Security numbers, financial account information, health records, or other sensitive information through a general inquiry.

7. Young people

DEINDE describes opportunities for young people ages 16–24. This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not intend to collect their personal information through general inquiries. If you are under 18, involve a parent or guardian before sending an inquiry. Separate youth-program participation and safeguarding processes may apply to future activities.

8. Your questions and requests

You may contact DEINDE to ask about personal information you have sent by email or to request a correction or deletion, subject to applicable law and legitimate retention obligations. We may need to verify your identity before addressing a request. Legal privacy rights may vary by jurisdiction.

9. External services and links

Any external site, email application, or third-party resource that you use has its own privacy practices. DEINDE is not responsible for those third-party policies.

10. Changes to this policy

We may update this notice to reflect changes in the Site or in applicable requirements. The revised notice and update date will appear on this page.

11. Contact

For privacy questions or requests, contact cjsmith410@gmail.com. DEINDE Enterprise Solutions is based in North Carolina.
